pages.text: The Energy Aggregator condenses a mountain of Akaishi Energy into something real:$(br2)$(bold)Two uses:$(0)$(li)$(4)10M energy + 1 Netherite Ingot -> 1 Akaishi Ingot$(0)$(li)$(4)10M energy + 1 Geode -> Geode one grade higher$(0) (Flawed -> Normal -> Pristine -> Perfect)$(br2)It carries a $(4)200M$(0) energy buffer and only takes power in — pipe energy over, drop in the material, and it works on its own.

$(bold)Remember this: the Aggregator is the only way to mass-produce Akaishi Ingots.$(0) It gates everything downstream — Akaishi gear, machine components, the whole industrial chain.$(br2)Geode upgrades run through it too: push a Flawed Geode all the way to Perfect and your crystal farm yields several times over.$(br2)Low on power? Add generators, mesh them into one grid with "$(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l)" and bank it in Energy Cells.
What the ingots build and how the Geode farm works: see "$(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:catalyst)Catalyst$(/l)".
